operations.summary: Create an organisation — a secondary of the current one, or the caller’s first
operations.description: With an organisation in the token: a SECONDARY (child) of it, the caller its OWNER — the token’s organisation must be a primary that has completed onboarding, the caller must hold `organization.children.create` there (re-read from the database, never from the token), and the parent must have fewer than the environment’s limit of children. The child takes the parent’s country. With NO organisation in the token: the caller’s first, PRIMARY organisation — allowed only while the person holds no active membership. An API key can create a secondary too: a LIVE key that was given `organization.children.create` by name (no key preset includes it; an Owner or Admin adds it when creating the key or by replacing its permissions). The new organisation is then recorded under the parent’s longest-standing Owner, who becomes its Owner. A sandbox key is refused: an organisation exists for both modes. An API key’s call is safe to repeat: send an `Idempotency-Key` header, or give the organization your own `externalReference`, and a repeated call returns the organization already created with `replayed: true` instead of making a second one. A key that also holds `organization.children.onboard` creates a sub-organization it may then onboard (`onboardingManaged: true`); that needs the parent to have accepted the current managed onboarding terms. A signed-in Owner or Admin in live mode gets the same with `groupOnboarding: true`, and may then send `externalReference` and an `Idempotency-Key` as a key does. Without either, a name is unique under its parent, so a repeated request answers 409 RES002 and the organisation is found with GET /a/v1/organizations/me/children. Neither branch issues a token or switches the session: call POST /a/v1/organizations/switch next. Answers 404 RES001 while secondary organisations are switched off in the environment.

disabledCause.description: Why it is disabled: `manual` (an update with `enabled: false`), `gone` (it answered 410), `consecutive_failures` (it failed for 72 hours and at least 20 attempts in a row), `live_access_revoked` (a live endpoint, when the organisation lost live access). Null while enabled.

failingSince.description: When the current run of failed attempts began; null when the latest attempt succeeded. Test deliveries do not count.

consecutiveFailures.description: Failed attempts in a row since the last success (test deliveries do not count); a success, or re-enabling the endpoint, resets it to 0.

previousSecretExpiresAt.description: Until when requests also carry a signature for the previous secret.

updatedAt.description: When the endpoint was last changed (by a member or by its delivery health).

version.description: The type’s version; every type is version 1 today.

scope.description: Who receives the type: `mode` (endpoints of the event’s mode), `live` (live endpoints only), `organization` (endpoints of both modes), `endpoint` (the organisation’s endpoints in the mode of the endpoint the event is about).

test.description: True for the event of a test send: delivered once, to that endpoint only, and never charged.

matchedEndpoints.description: How many endpoints the event was queued for when it was logged; a replay does not change it.

receivedAt.description: When the event was logged; the log keeps 30 days.

version.description: The type’s version; every type is version 1 today.

family.description: The subscription family; every type of a family needs the same capability.

scope.description: Who receives the type: `mode` (endpoints of the event’s mode), `live` (live endpoints only), `organization` (endpoints of both modes), `endpoint` (the organisation’s endpoints in the mode of the endpoint the event is about).

status.description: `available` (its source event is emitted today), `pending_source` (defined; its source event is not emitted yet), `invoice` (produced by the invoice service, or by webhooks themselves for `webhook_endpoint.*`), `future` (waits for a later feature; nothing is delivered).

requiredCapability.description: The capability that reads the same data through the API. A pattern delivers the type only when the member who wrote it held this capability.

subscribable.description: Whether the caller holds the capability the type needs.

log.description: How long the delivery log is kept.

endpointId.description: The endpoint asked for; null for all of them.

days.description: Every UTC day the window touches, oldest first, zeros included.

delivering.description: An attempt is being made now.

retrying.description: An attempt failed; another is scheduled.

deliveredPercent.description: Delivered ÷ (delivered + failed) × 100 for the day, rounded down to one decimal; null when none finished.

log.description: How long the delivery log is kept.

state.description: `none` (no endpoint is on or off by its own failures); `failing` (one is failing or off by its failures); `degraded` (one is not answering, or a delivery is retrying); else `healthy`.

endpoints.description: Each endpoint not deleted, oldest first, then each deleted one counted.

types.description: Each event type counted, by name.

total.description: Deliveries counted; the five statuses add up to it.

deliveredPercent.description: Delivered ÷ (delivered + failed) × 100, rounded DOWN to one decimal (100 means none failed); null when none finished.

responseTime.description: How long the endpoint took to answer.

host.description: The URL’s host only, lower case: never its path, query or port.

status.description: The endpoint’s status now.

disabledCause.description: Why it is disabled; null while enabled.

failingSince.description: The start of its current run of failed attempts; null after any success.

deletedAt.description: When it was deleted; null for an endpoint that is not.

state.description: `healthy`; `not_answering` (failing under 24 h); `failing` (24 h or more); `disabled_by_failures`; `off` (turned off by a member, or live access ended); `deleted`.

keptDays.description: Days the delivery log is kept.

startsAt.description: Where the kept log starts now: `keptDays` before now.

total.description: Deliveries counted; the five statuses add up to it.

deliveredPercent.description: Delivered ÷ (delivered + failed) × 100, rounded DOWN to one decimal (100 means none failed); null when none finished.

responseTime.description: How long the endpoint took to answer.

from.description: The start counted: the one asked for, or the start of the kept log if later.

to.description: The end counted, exclusive: the one asked for, or now if earlier.

measured.description: Attempts timed: answered with any HTTP status, or timed out.

medianMs.description: The median time to answer, in milliseconds; null when nothing was timed.

p95Ms.description: The 95th percentile, in milliseconds; null when nothing was timed.

timedOut.description: Of the timed attempts, those that timed out.

deliveryId.description: The queued test delivery; follow it in the delivery log.

type.description: The type sent: the one asked for, or `webhook_endpoint.pinged` when none was.

total.description: How many items match, across every page.

totalPages.description: `ceil(total / pageSize)`; an empty set is 0 pages.

hasNext.description: True when a page follows this one.

hasPrevious.description: True when a page precedes this one.

nextPage.description: Reserved for a link to the next page; no route sends it. Page with `page` and `hasNext`.

previousPage.description: Reserved for a link to the previous page; no route sends it. Page with `page` and `hasPrevious`.

currentPage.description: Reserved for a link to this page; no route sends it.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status of the response, repeated.

message.description: Copy for humans. Never branch on it.

requestId.description: This service’s request id (also the `x-request-id` header) — quote it in a bug report.

availableMinor.description: Kobo the account may spend now.

ledgerMinor.description: Kobo on the ledger (available plus holds and pending).

holdMinor.description: Kobo the bank holds on the account, as the bank reports it; 0 when it reports none.

pendingMinor.description: Kobo the bank reports as pending; 0 when it reports none.

asOf.description: When the bank answered these figures.

stale.description: True when the figures are older than the refresh window and the bank could not be asked.

status.description: `requested` (KYB approved; waiting for the bank to create the account), `opening` (the bank is issuing the number), `open`, `frozen` (the bank froze it), `closed` (the bank closed it), `opening_failed` (the bank refused to open it; see `failureReason`).

accountNumber.description: The organisation’s own NUBAN, in full; null until the account is open.

accountNumberLast4.description: The last four digits of the NUBAN (what events and notices carry).

accountName.description: The account’s name at the bank; null until the bank issues the number.

bankName.description: The name of the bank that holds the account; null until it is open.

bankNipCode.description: The bank’s NIP code (what a payer’s bank app needs).

bankPaystackCode.description: The bank’s Paystack code (what billing’s settlement needs).

balance.description: The bank’s latest figures; null before the account opened or was ever read.

frozenCause.description: Why the account is frozen: `provider` (the bank froze it). Null unless `frozen`.

closedCause.description: Why the account is closed: `provider` (the bank closed it). Null unless `closed`.

sendBlockedReason.description: Reserved: a reason of ours to refuse transfers from the account (a transfer or a bulk payment is then refused 409 `BIZ402` naming it). Nothing sets it today, so it is null.

settlementOptIn.description: This account’s opt-in as billing’s collection settlement account; the settlement read has the detail.

transferLimits.description: The transfer limits in force, and what is left of today’s.

openedAt.description: When the bank issued the number and the account opened; null before.

createdAt.description: When the account was requested, as the KYB profile was approved.

status.description: This account’s opt-in as billing’s collection settlement account: `none` (never opted in), `pending` (the bank’s name enquiry has not agreed yet; retried hourly), `active` (opted in), `failed` (the enquiry did not agree in 24 tries, or another settlement account appeared that the member had not agreed to replace), `stale` (the account closed while it was active).

settlementAccountId.description: Billing’s settlement account row, once opted in.

name.description: The other side’s account name, as the bank gave it: the payer of a credit, the beneficiary of a transfer. Null when unknown.

bankName.description: The other side’s bank; null when unknown.

accountNumberLast4.description: The other side’s account number, last four digits only.

nickname.description: The saved counterparty’s nickname, for an outbound transfer to one; null otherwise.

kind.description: `inbound_credit` (money received), `inbound_reversal` (a received credit the sender’s bank reversed), `outbound_transfer` (a transfer sent), `outbound_reversal` (a sent transfer the bank returned), `fee` (reserved; not recorded today).

direction.description: `credit` (money in: a received credit, a returned transfer) or `debit` (money out: a transfer, a reversed credit).

status.description: `pending` (recorded, not settled yet), `completed`, `failed` (a transfer that did not go through), `reversed` (reversed later; the reversal is its own row naming this one).

amountMinor.description: Kobo.

feeMinor.description: Kobo: the bank’s own naira fee on this movement (0 for an outbound transfer; its fee is in credits, `creditsCharged`).

creditsCharged.description: For an outbound transfer: the credits billing took when the transfer completed (the transfer’s fee). Null until then, when no fee was taken, and on every other kind of row.

narration.description: The narration: the bank’s narration on a credit, the transfer’s narration on a transfer (`REVERSAL …` on its return). Null when there was none.

counterparty.description: The other side of the movement; null when the bank named none.

sessionId.description: The NIP session id, when the bank gave one.

bankReference.description: The banking partner’s own id for this movement (its statement row), the reference to quote to the bank; null until the partner’s read names it.

transferId.description: The transfer the row records: an outbound transfer or its reversal. Null on other rows.

relatedTransactionId.description: For a reversal: the row it reverses.

confirmation.description: `confirmed` once the bank’s own read agreed with the callback.

occurredAt.description: When the movement happened; for a transfer, normally when it was authorised.

accountName.description: The bank’s name for the account.

nickname.description: The saved counterparty’s nickname (the portal’s label), when the member gave one.

principalType.description: Who made the transfer: `user` (a member) or `system` (a scheduled run of a bulk payment).

principalId.description: The member’s user id, or `schedules.due` for a scheduled run.

status.description: `authorised` (the step-up passed; not with the bank yet), `submitted` (the bank has it), `completed`, `failed`, `reversed` (the bank returned it after it completed), `abandoned` (authorised, never sent: the fee could not be held).

amountMinor.description: Kobo.

reference.description: The partner reference (`yt` + 32 hex), derived from the id.

creditsState.description: The credits side: held at authorisation, captured when completed, released when failed, refunded when reversed after completion.

creditsCharged.description: The transfer fee: the credits billing took when the transfer completed. Null until then, and for a transfer whose fee was never taken (failed, abandoned, or the hold had lapsed).

failureReason.description: Why the transfer did not complete or was returned: `credits_refused` or `billing_unavailable` when abandoned; otherwise the bank’s own reason or code, or `provider_failed` / `reversed_by_bank` when the bank gave none. Null otherwise.

submittedAt.description: When the bank took the transfer; null before.

settledAt.description: When the transfer last reached a final state (`completed`, `failed`, `reversed`, `abandoned`); null while `authorised` or `submitted`.

replayed.description: True when this answer replays an earlier request under the same Idempotency-Key; absent otherwise.

dailyMaxMinor.description: The most sent in one UTC day, kobo.

dailyRemainingMinor.description: What is left of today’s limit, kobo (never below 0).
